name: manual_0425d3
claim: After a PR merges, always verify origin/main contains every commit on the feature branch — unattended merges and continued pushes to the same branch name leave post-merge commits orphaned until a follow-up PR is opened.

decisions.notes: PT #177 merged at 3a287da while cursor/security-pr1-pr2-auth-hardening-f559 continued with c3957d7 and 861793a; required follow-up PR #179.
